job.text: Look up each department's expenses in 2022

reasons.chart.value_labels: the book's chart keeps its scale (p. 158): this example shows the names wrapping under columns, and P2-07 adds its budget markers

source.shows: names that wrap to keep the columns: on one line “Marketing” and “Finance & Admin” would be 6.3 pt apart, under 1 em, so every multi-word name wraps, balanced and never just before “&”, giving the book’s “Finance & / Admin”; then all names keep 1 em apart. The book’s budget markers are phase 2, so only the expenses are drawn, as a look-up chart
